mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a major interior home renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a major interior home renovation varies significantly based on scope. A kitchen remodel might take 6-10 weeks, while a bathroom remodel could be 4-8 weeks. Whole-home renovations often span 3-6 months or more, depending on structural changes, material availability, and permitting processes.
